'''Spagga Core, Incorporated''' was a mining company based in the [[Minos Cluster/Legends|Minos Cluster]]. The company mainly mined rare gems for use in [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] weapons. During the height of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the company was the center of rumors that they had reserved the exclusive mining rights to an unidentified planet in the Minos Cluster in order to gather [[Corusca gem/Legends|Corusca gems]]. The company's biggest competitor was the [[Damarind Corporation]].
